coverageGaps.message: This looks like it may be about something other than AI. Knowledge covers AI and developer topics.

tools.name: AI Prompt Builder
tools.reason: Use it when you are drafting a prompt. It walks through role, request, context, process, tone and output, then assembles one prompt you can copy. It does not call a model.

tools.name: Prompt Diff
tools.reason: Use it to compare two prompt versions and see which lines were added or removed. It does not measure whether the model got better.

tools.name: Fact Anchor Checker
tools.reason: Use it to check claims in an answer against source text you paste. It is a manual spot-check, not a way to stop hallucinations in general.

tools.name: PII & Secret Redactor
tools.reason: Use it to mask emails, phone numbers and API-key-like strings before you paste text anywhere. Pattern matching is not exhaustive, so read the result.

tools.name: Agentic Workflow Generator
tools.reason: Use it when you already know you want a workflow and need roles, handoffs, inputs and guardrails written down. It does not explain what an agent is, and it does not run the workflow.

tools.name: JSON Formatter
tools.reason: Use it to validate and pretty-print JSON in the browser. It does not design a schema or call a model.
